Routines for seating plans in detail
This section outlines why careful work counts

Seating and Handling Guidance

This section supports careful, calm service for every companion animal and traveler who comes to Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk must place each booking according to the animal's size, temperament, carrier condition, and the comfort needs of nearby travelers. Staff should confirm the care plan, keep voices low, and use clear language so that passengers understand each step without confusion.

When a traveler arrives with a companion animal, the desk team should review documents, confirm the approved carrier, and guide the traveler to the correct waiting point. <<FACT F019>> The team must also watch for signs of stress and, when needed, give the traveler a quiet route that reduces handling and keeps the animal settled.

For shared space planning, the desk should coordinate closely with ground staff so that seating choices protect the animal and preserve a smooth flow through the area. <<FACT F009>> If a traveler needs special assistance, the shift coordinator should assign a calm colleague and keep the record complete before the animal moves onward.

Relief-area access must be handled with care, and staff should give directions only to approved travelers after the usual checks are finished. <<FACT F013>> The desk should never leave a traveler uncertain about where to go, and any concern about safety or welfare must be escalated at once. Please contact the shift coordinator or the duty supervisor for any case that falls outside routine handling.
